name: Cold waves & winter storms
summary: No top-tier cold or winter-storm warning across a major region on 20 Nov; UK yellow snow and cold alerts have ended
state: The Met Office issued a yellow snow warning for parts of southern Scotland and northern England for 17 Nov, and UKHSA a yellow cold-health alert for northern England until 19 Nov (Met Office). US winter storm warnings for the Sierra Nevada expired early on 20 Nov (NWS via Defcon Level). These are lower-tier or mountain warnings, and searches on 20 Nov found no top-tier cold warning across a major region and no cold-related power or gas outages, so Normal is kept.
for_you: Travel on high routes in snow-prone areas can be disrupted. Follow the Met Office, UKHSA cold-health alerts or your national weather service for local warnings.
rubric_hit: Normal: only yellow-level UK warnings and mountain winter storm warnings; no top-tier cold warning across a major region

sources.title: Met Office — Snow warning in force as unsettled weather continues
Defcon Level — NWS Sacramento winter storm warning until 20 Nov 4:00am PST

why: Severe cold and winter storms kill, cut power and spike gas demand, as in Texas in 2021; they matter most when energy supplies are tight.
drivers: Polar vortex disruption, blocking highs, ENSO, Arctic outbreaks.

rubric.alert: Deadly cold or winter storms with widespread power or gas outages.
rubric.watch: Top-tier cold or winter-storm warnings across a major region, or a cold wave lifting gas demand sharply.
rubric.normal: No major cold wave or winter storm affecting large populations.
